_about: Rodolfo Lanciani (1847-1929), Roman archaeologist, writing in English. Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics): Pagan and Christian Rome, clean Gutenberg. No uids minted.  Round dz (antiquities sweep) adds eight of his English books on Roman topography and archaeology.
